title: Warm Crispy Brazilian Peach Skewers
description: A sweet and crispy Brazilian dish featuring peaches, perfect for any occasion, this recipe is also sugar-free-friendly by using natural sweeteners like honey and the sweetness of the peaches themselves.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, malt extract, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and honey until well combined.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Cut the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Place a peach slice in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the peach to form a triangle or a square shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with coconut oil.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
